title: Vance calls out ‘neoconservatives’ over Iran war
html:
Vance calls out ‘neoconservatives’ over Iran war

US Vice President JD Vance told Fox News that ‘neoconservatives’ want the Iran war to become a forever war, but vowed that President Trump would not allow for a long-term commitment to the war. Vance has acknowledged the political cost to the war on gas and energy prices as well.
summary: US Vice President JD Vance told Fox News that ‘neoconservatives’ want the Iran war to become a forever war.
